tools.name: get_grid_context
tools.description: Return the latest typed GridDyn/HELICS context packet, including observations, simulation time, events, data quality, unknowns, and decision boundaries.

tools.name: get_grid_events
tools.description: Return recent HELICS endpoint messages with source, destination, simulation time, payload, and evidence IDs.

tools.name: get_gateway_health
tools.description: Return connection state, HELICS version, simulation time, counts, last update, and read-only status.

tools.name: validate_agent_claims
tools.description: Check that each proposed agent claim cites evidence_ids that exist in the current context packet. Body: {"claims":[{"text":"...","evidence_ids":["obs:..."]}]}

tools.name: preview_control_request
tools.description: Explicitly reject actuation attempts and return the safety boundary. This endpoint never sends a HELICS command.

tools.name: get_context_schema
tools.description: Return the JSON Schema for the agent context packet.

agent_rules: Use only evidence present in the latest context packet.
Do not convert missing, stale, or held values into current observations.
Keep observed, simulated, inferred, and recommended content separate.
Cite one or more evidence_ids for every numerical or causal claim.
If evidence is missing or contradictory, return insufficient_evidence.
Do not issue control actions through this gateway; require a separate human-approved control service.
